'''Essor''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Essowyn]], the [[Saurton]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. It was located in the north-eastern hemisphere, on a island, located to north-west from the continent of [[Steltout]].
